source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Keeping the medication easily accessible to any children in the household for the sake of everyday convenience at home","B":"Storing the medication alongside all of the family's other everyday household medications, without any special separate precautions taken","C":"Fairly few special handling precautions actually being needed for oral chemotherapy medications that are kept in the home","D":"Using gloves when handling the medication if the client cannot self-administer, storing it separately and securely, and following specific disposal guidance"}}
source_row.rationale: Safe home handling of oral chemotherapy includes using gloves if a caregiver must handle the medication (rather than the client self-administering), storing it separately and securely from other household medications, and following specific disposal guidance, given the hazardous nature of these medications even in oral form.
